description: Brief §5 scenario: a cumulative idle-seconds totalizer (odometer) that a naive dashboard SUMS instead of differences. Single day, no reset, stair-step export (counter-friendly). Hand-truthed: naive sum of idle_seconds_total = 87000; honest period increase = last - first = 24000 - 0 = 24000. The dashboard overstates idle time by 3.6x -- the contrast IS the diagnosis.
